description: Agent Roles: submit an agent’s role description: the role with its id, title and version, the purpose it states, each task in scope with its id and the outcome it delivers, the tasks out of scope, each success measure with its target, the decisions the role may make alone and the description as written, read for open-ended wording such as other duties as assigned, as needed or help with anything. The signed report gives the purpose with whether it names a result, every task with its outcome and whether it is also excluded, the exclusions, every success measure with its target and any opinion wording, the open-ended wording found and the decisions, and counts them, and names a vague role: no purpose, no tasks in scope, no success measure, open-ended duty wording, a measure that leaves success to opinion such as looks good or happy, and a task listed both in and out of scope; then no exclusions, tasks with no outcome, measures with no target, a purpose that names an activity rather than a result and no decisions the role makes alone, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No description text leaves the definition unverified. This reads the role description an agent could act on without guessing: a goal’s outcome and success test are wever_goal-statement-check and the rule set an operator hands an agent is wever_adoption-readiness-check. Verdict role_definition_vague, role_definition_partial, role_definition_unverified or role_definition_clear. POST /api/role-definition-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.
